projects.title: Molar Money
projects.description:
Developed a web-based platform designed to simplify dental insurance and help users better understand coverage, benefits, and out-of-pocket costs.

• Collaborated with a team to design, build, and deploy a functional application within a hackathon timeframe.
• Developed tools focused on making dental insurance information and cost considerations more accessible and understandable for users.
• Rapidly prototyped and iterated on the product based on the problem space, user experience, and technical requirements.
• Won the codeLinc 11 Hackathon for the completed solution.
